text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
『That is proof that
he is a first-rate plasterer』

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Grandpa's amazing...
To be featured even on American TV shows.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Related videos...
Ah, there are comments here too...!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...I wonder if there are any others.
Videos about Grandpa, I mean..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Believe ended up going down a rabbit hole of videos about her grandfather, staying up way too late...
